import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction amount distribution by type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
transaction_types = data.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(transaction_types))
transaction_types.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction distribution by hour of day
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
hour_counts = data['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax2.bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Frequency by Hour', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Scatter plot: Amount vs Hour colored by transaction type
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax3.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
               label=trans_type, s=150, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Type', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Transaction type distribution (pie chart)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(type_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                     colors=colors_pie, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax4.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
